basics.name: Zadkiel AHARONIAN
basics.label: Kubernetes Platform Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer / OSS Maintainer
basics.summary: Hands-on Kubernetes platform engineer and SRE with **10+ years of experience**, focused on self-service platforms, GitOps automation, edge/onboard systems, GPU/AI compute and reliable multi-cloud operations. Led a self-service Kubernetes platform product at CCL and internal platform modernization at Carrefour; **OSS maintainer** in the Kubernetes/Helm ecosystem, exploring agentic coding and AI-assisted platform workflows.

work.name: Airbus Aircraft
work.summary: Cloud-native and edge platforms for next-generation onboard aircraft systems.
highlights: Delivered MVPs combining edge computing, content delivery and Kubernetes-based infrastructure.
Designed Kubernetes foundations for onboard application management, aircraft systems and rollout-constrained environments.
Built Varnish-based onboard video/content distribution and Jetson/GPU real-time computer-vision pipelines.

work.name: CCL Consulting
work.summary: Kubernetes platform engineering and DevOps consulting in a multi-client service center.
highlights: Led development of a **self-service Kubernetes platform product** and Go-based CLI to bootstrap clusters and application stacks from declarative config, with GitOps delivery, layered Helm/Kustomize composition, secret hydration and repeatable local/cloud/bare-metal environments.
Developed a **Kubernetes compliance engine** for real-time security and best-practice visibility across developers, compliance teams and operators.
Delivered platform maintenance and enhancements for 10+ clients using immutable infrastructure, GitOps workflows and modern security practices.

work.name: Carrefour
work.summary: Internal Kubernetes platform team for Carrefour product teams, operating shared clusters and platform services across GKE, Rancher RKE, Azure IaaS/Kubespray and AKS.
highlights: Operated and modernized 10+ Kubernetes clusters across multiple clouds, up to 200 nodes each, serving 50 product teams.
Led **RKE to AKS migration** with GitOps, immutable infrastructure, security guardrails and upgradeable platform baselines.
Built self-service Kubernetes platform capabilities, resource-efficiency practices, PagerDuty workflows, runbooks and alert tuning.
Developed and contributed to Kubernetes controllers/operators for multi-tenancy, logging and platform automation.
